rows.en: See you, \p-san.
rows.notes: Grace to the female player (scd_com_728).

rows.en:
(So that's Sheryl-san's manager, Grace-san.
She seemed like a really kind, nice person...)

(Oh, right, I'd better hurry and take Sheryl-san
the thing she forgot...)
rows.notes: The forgotten item is her swimsuit (earlier in the scene).

rows.en:
That's it for today's class!
All of you, fall in!
rows.notes: x4: scd_com_824 and scd_fes_811, both genders.

rows.en:
(So that's the last class of the school year...
What should I do over summer break?)
rows.notes: Shared male/female.

rows.en:
Jeez, you lot. Don't go getting all giddy
just 'cause summer break starts next week.
rows.notes: x4 (also scd_fes_811).

rows.en:
Right now, the Frontier is under threat
from those Vajra things that nobody
can make any sense of.

Somewhere down the road, the Frontier
might get hit by one hell of a crisis...

But I'm pretty sure I've trained you lot
well enough to at least keep yourselves alive.
rows.notes: hazu: 'I should have trained you enough to protect your own lives yourselves'.

rows.en:
You lot...
Show up for the new term alive and kicking!
That's one order you'd better not break!!
rows.notes: Literally 'come to school with healthy faces; keep this one rule no matter what'.

rows.en:
Well, that was pretty stiff talk coming from me,
but it's summer break, after all.
Go make yourselves some summer memories.

(Like Gary-sensei said, you can't exactly
call the Frontier safe right now, but...)
rows.notes: Shared male/female.

rows.en:
(It's summer break, after all.
Having fun has gotta be the top priority!)

(All right, I'm gonna enjoy summer break
to the fullest!)

(It's summer break, after all.
Having fun is obviously the top priority!)

(All right, I'm going to enjoy summer break
to the fullest!)
(So today's the graduation ceremony...)

(There weren't any seniors I was especially
close to this year, but still, just knowing it's
graduation makes me kinda wistful...)

(Once summer break's over, we'll be
third-years too... Next year, it'll be
our own graduation......)

(All right! I've gotta enjoy the rest of
high school as hard as I can, so I don't
have any regrets!)
(So today's the graduation ceremony...)

(There weren't any seniors I was especially
close to this year, but still, just knowing it's
graduation makes me a little wistful...)

(Once summer break's over, we'll be
third-years too... So next year, it'll be
our own graduation......)

(All right! I've got to enjoy the rest of
high school as hard as I can, so I don't
have any regrets!)

(Wow, what a shock! I can't believe I actually
won that autographed Sheryl card I entered
the drawing for the other day...)
rows.notes: sain shikishi = autographed card (board).

rows.en: (Hehe, I've gotta brag to everyone.)

Morning, \p-kun.
What's with the happy face?

Morning, Ranka.
Guess what, I won an autographed Sheryl ca...
rows.notes: Cut off mid-word as in the Japanese (atat...).

rows.en: Wait......
rows.notes: Shared male/female; the player notices Ranka's uniform.

rows.en:
Why are you wearing a Mihoshi uniform, Ranka?!
And you're just walking to school like normal...

Huh? Didn't I tell you?
As of today, I've transferred to Mihoshi Academy.

What?! You transferred?
Why so suddenly...?
rows.notes: Shared male/female.

rows.en:
Well, I got scouted by a talent agency,
and once I started working, I couldn't stay
at my old school anymore...

Well then, since we're both here,
shall we head to class together?

This is Ranka Lee-kun, who transfers
to Mihoshi Academy as of today.
I expect you all to get along with her.
rows.notes: Yamashiro uses -kun for students of either gender.

rows.en:
(Ranka will fit right in with the class
in no time, so I'm not worried.)

As it happens, Ranka-kun is not the only one.
We have one more transfer student...

(Two transfers at once? That's something...
I wonder what the other one's like?)
rows.notes: donna ko: gender of the newcomer unknown to the player; kept neutral.

rows.en: Sorry, but would you come in, please?

...Ah!
Wha?......No way?!
Sheryl Nome......?
Quiet down, all of you.

(Why is Sheryl Nome, the Galactic Fairy,
at Mihoshi Academy?)
...It's like a dream.

(Not just Ranka, but the Galactic Fairy
herself transferring here too...)
(This isn't a dream, right?)

(Wow, what a shock! I can't believe I actually
won that autographed Sheryl card I entered
the drawing for the other day...)
(Hehe, I've got to brag to everyone.)

Morning, \p-chan.
What's with the happy face?

Morning, Ranka-chan.
Guess what, I won an autographed Sheryl ca...
rows.notes: Bare 'Sheryl' as in the Japanese (product name).

rows.en:
Why are you wearing a Mihoshi uniform,
Ranka-chan?! And you're just walking
to school like normal...

Well then, since we're both here,
why don't we head to class together?

(Ranka-chan will fit right in with the class
in no time, so I'm not worried.)

(Two transfers at once? That's amazing...
I wonder what the other one's like?)

(Why is Sheryl Nome, the Galactic Fairy,
at Mihoshi Academy?)

(Not just Ranka-chan, but the Galactic Fairy
herself transferring here too...)
(This isn't a dream... is it?)

(Ever since Sheryl came to Mihoshi,
the whole school's been in an uproar...)

(But why did Sheryl transfer to Mihoshi
in the first place?)

(Could it be she read the message I sent...
Nah, no way.)
(Hm? I hear voices. What's going on?)

Thanks to Sheryl's little whim,
our plans have been thrown off course...
rows.notes: Grace before she is named (??? plate).

rows.en: (The voices were coming from over here...)
Who the hell are you?
rows.notes: Brera before he is named; kisama kept at full strength.

rows.en:
(Huh?! Why is someone pointing
a knife at me?!)
Stop that, Brera.
Understood...
(Ph-phew... I'm saved...)

I'm sorry about that.
He's a bodyguard, but his one little flaw
is that he's far too serious.

O-oh, I see...
So, um... who are you?
rows.notes: Shared male/female.

rows.en:
Oh, you're Sheryl's manager?
I'm \p.

So you're...
\p-kun...
(She knows who I am?)

You and that uncalled-for message
you sent to Sheryl...
rows.notes: Grace mutters with contemptuous kisama; the player half-hears it. Shared male/female.

rows.en: Huh? Did you just say something?
Hehe, it's nothing at all.

And this is Brera Sterne,
who serves as Sheryl's bodyguard.
Brera Sterne.
Nice to meet you.
rows.notes: Shared male/female.

rows.en: (No reaction...)

uncertain: c23433: '??? (man)' plate is Brera; 'Who the hell are you?' for kisama.
c23443: Grace's aside rendered as a muttered fragment ('You and that uncalled-for message...'); the Japanese is 'because you sent Sheryl an uncalled-for message...', trailing.
